name: Induced-draft fan, stack and FGR ducting
description: Induced-draft fan and flue-gas path that maintain furnace draft and discharge products to stack. Stacks and ductwork are engineered from flue-gas volume, temperature and space constraints; dampers hold a set draft loss and an SCR reactor house is sized from the catalyst mass required to meet the emission limit. FGR ducting returns a controlled share of flue gas to the forced-draft intake. Primary source: https://halgopower.com/products/stacks-and-ductwork

specifications.basis: Flue-gas volumetric flow, flue-gas temperature, space constraints and optional catalyst modules
Maintain a predetermined draft loss; parallel or opposed blade with pneumatic actuators common
Dimensions set by the amount and density of catalyst needed to meet the specified emission limit
Induced FGR on the SBR-5 burner gives 5 ppm NOx at about 3% O2

gaps.what: ID fan datasheets and quantified FGR ratios
gaps.why: The read pages give function and arrangement but no fan curves, duties or recirculation percentages.
gaps.next_action: Read fan and FGR datasheets for a specific boiler or HRSG.
